Interface CommandWithProgress

All Superinterfaces:
Command
All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseCommand, FallbackCommand, GarageDownCommand, GarageUpCommand, LightOffCommand, LightOnCommand, MacroCommand, StereoOffCommand, StereoOnCommand, StereoPlayCDCommand, StereoStopPlaybackCommand, StereoVolumeDownCommand, StereoVolumeUpCommand
public interface CommandWithProgress extends Command
Interface for commands that support duration and progress tracking. Used for showing progress bars during macro execution.

    • getDurationMs

      long getDurationMs()

    • executeWithProgress

      default void executeWithProgress(CommandWithProgress.ProgressCallback progressCallback) throws InterruptedException
      Execute the command with a progress callback. Default implementation just calls execute() after the duration.
      Parameters:
      progressCallback - Callback to report progress (0.0 to 1.0)
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if execution is interrupted
